reason: The README clearly describes an AI-oriented automation layer for EasyEDA Pro that uses a CLI, agent skill, and stdio MCP adapter to execute typed schematic and PCB design actions, validations, and exports through a local connector and daemon.

summaries.zh: 通过 CLI、Agent Skill 和本地 MCP 连接器，使用类型化动作自动化执行 EasyEDA Pro 的原理图与 PCB 设计流程。
summaries.en: Automates EasyEDA Pro schematic and PCB workflows through typed actions exposed via a CLI, Agent Skill, and local MCP connector.

capabilities: Automates EasyEDA Pro schematic and PCB editing through typed actions
Connects a local daemon to an EasyEDA connector over WebSocket
Exports design artifacts including BOMs, netlists, and screenshots
Runs design checks such as layout validation and DRC
Records audit logs and workflow results
